property_mix.era: predominantly Edwardian and interwar with significant post-war infill
property_mix.notable: Seaside resort town with substantial Victorian/Edwardian villa stock; many period properties converted to holiday lets and HMOs. Aging population means numerous elderly residents in original properties with outdated locks.

locksmith_relevant: Edwardian villas dominate; many have original sash windows and period mortice locks requiring specialist knowledge and careful handling.
High holiday let turnover means frequent tenant changeovers and emergency re-keying demands, particularly in seafront and near-town properties.
Aging residential population creates steady demand for accessibility upgrades: lever handles, electronic locks, and assisted entry solutions in period homes.
